title: Order Fulfillment — Local Operations
description: Provisioned local operating dashboard for the three fulfillment applications. No external exporters or cloud validation are implied.

options.content: Data comes from authenticated application scrapes every 15s. DNS discovery includes all replicas. Fresh, successful shared database snapshots use the maximum per status/step across replicas, then sum steps. Use the snapshot health panels before interpreting backlog. **No data** means no matching samples or no traffic; it is not proof of zero errors. HTTP panels exclude Actuator traffic. Alerts are local Prometheus rules; notifications are not configured.

panels.title: Reachable replicas
panels.description: Number of successful scrape targets, filtered by service/instance. Expected targets depend on configured replicas.

panels.title: Pending orders
panels.description: Shared database count, deduplicated across replicas. Instance filter is intentionally ignored for shared gauges.

panels.title: Manual review
panels.description: Parked orders needing operator review. Read snapshot health before acting.

panels.title: Oldest pending
panels.description: Maximum pending age across database snapshots; includes retry backoff.

panels.title: Oldest snapshot
panels.description: Time since last successful snapshot. Failed refresh retains the last snapshot; before first success values are unknown.

panels.title: Firing local alerts
panels.description: All local Prometheus alerts, independent of service/instance filters. Open Prometheus /alerts for details.

panels.title: Application requests / second
panels.description: Includes all application routes and excludes Actuator; the URI label is a route template.

panels.title: HTTP p95 / p99
panels.description: Aggregated classic histogram quantiles, enabled by the common application configuration. No traffic gives no quantile.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx ratio
panels.description: An absent error meter can produce No data before the first 5xx; inspect HTTP counts and target health together.

panels.title: Mean HTTP latency
panels.description: Request-weighted mean from timer sum/count; no requests means no measurement.

panels.title: Saga backlog by status / step
panels.description: Fresh successful snapshots only. Every replica reads the same database; maximum deduplicates counts. This can briefly overestimate between refreshes. Instance filter is intentionally ignored.

panels.title: Retry attempts due
panels.description: Pending orders that have a prior failed attempt and are now due, from the shared database snapshot.

panels.title: Saga phase outcomes / second
panels.description: Advanced/deferred/parked counts are recorded after transaction commit; rolled_back and unknown report transaction completion separately. Counters appear after the first corresponding event.

panels.title: Saga phase processing p95
panels.description: Transaction phase processing duration, including dependency calls. No matching execution gives no data.

panels.title: Snapshot refresh health
panels.description: Per-instance refresh success: 1 after a successful refresh, 0 on failure/startup. The top snapshot age stat shows time since the last successful snapshot; failed/stale snapshots are excluded from shared backlog records.

panels.title: Snapshot refresh failures / second
panels.description: Refresh failures do not turn unknown/stale database state into a zero backlog.

panels.title: Redis catalog cache and database fallback
Cache checks / second
panels.description: Cache checks, not HTTP requests. The singleflight leader may check twice; bypasses and errors are not request counts.

panels.title: Catalog request source / second
panels.description: One catalog lookup timer per request. Sources distinguish Redis, database and coalesced results; use this for request source proportions.

panels.title: Redis mean operation time
panels.description: Application-observed Redis operation time. This is not a Redis server exporter and does not measure Redis CPU or memory.

panels.title: Database catalog reads / second
panels.description: Database fallback and cold reads for catalog display; purchase quotes/reservations remain database authoritative.

panels.title: Singleflight activity / second
panels.description: Leaders, coalesced followers and admission bypasses. Interpret with Redis errors and cache inflight.

panels.title: Cache in-flight keys
panels.description: Per-instance in-memory coalescing entries, not a shared cache size.

panels.title: JVM, database pool, and event outbox
JVM heap used / max
panels.description: Heap values from each application process. A max of -1 means undefined and is excluded.

panels.title: Process CPU utilization
panels.description: JVM process CPU gauge, normalized by available processors. Container limits still apply.

panels.title: Hikari active / pending / max connections
panels.description: Per-instance connection pool gauges. With replicas, total database connections grow with each configured pool.

panels.title: GC pause time / second
panels.description: Seconds spent in observed GC pauses per wall second; inspect alongside heap and request latency.

panels.title: Unpublished outbox events
panels.description: Shared database count per service, deduplicated across replicas. Existing outbox gauges query the database during each scrape.

panels.title: Oldest unpublished event
panels.description: Time since the oldest unpublished event was created. Inspect broker health and delivery retries if age grows.

panels.title: Outbox publish / failure rate
panels.description: Counters are local to the process. Publication is at least once; a crash after broker acknowledgment may replay an event.

panels.title: Scrape health per replica
panels.description: 1 = authenticated scrape succeeded, 0 = scrape failed. A vanished DNS target is detected by the separate missing-target alert.
